name: BENZOCAINE 0.1/1G GRAPE FLAVOR GEL SIMI BABY
description: Immediate-acting local anesthetic that provides temporary relief from gum discomfort caused by teething. It has a pleasant grape flavor and is easy to apply. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
